title: Veterans Pension Recurring Countable Income — Sources and Figures
content:
## Recurring countable income — Veterans Pension

The recurring countable income is the veteran's Social Security, plus the spouse's Social Security where the rate category counts spouse income, plus his federal civil service annuity, plus interest and dividends, plus recurring VA disability compensation, rounded to the cent.

Each Social Security figure, the annuity figure and the interest figure are taken as reported on the most recent report of that source — the one most recently received — and a source with no report on file adds nothing. Interest and dividends are counted at the figure most recently reported. Recurring compensation is the monthly rate of the veteran's Disability Compensation rating for a veteran alone, for 12 months.

| Source | Figure taken | Added where |
|---|---|---|
| Veteran's Social Security | annual figure on the latest Social Security report | always |
| Spouse's Social Security | annual figure on the latest spouse income report | the rate category counts spouse income |
| Federal civil service annuity | annual figure on the latest annuity report | always |
| Interest and dividends | figure on the latest interest and dividends report | always |
| VA disability compensation | monthly rate of the rating for a veteran alone, times 12 | always |

### Worked example (hypothetical veteran in Veterans Pension (Basic Rate, One Dependent))

Veteran's Social Security 13200.00; spouse's Social Security 7800.00; no annuity report; interest and dividends 350.00; Disability Compensation rating with a monthly rate for a veteran alone of 180.42.

Compensation: 180.42 times 12 is 2165.04. Total: 13200.00 plus 7800.00 plus 0 plus 350.00 plus 2165.04, which is 23515.04. In a no-dependent category the spouse's 7800.00 would not be added, giving 15715.04.
